title: Nix-TOPS law file (laws/N-NN.toml)
description: One law of the Nix-TOPS catalog (NIX_TOPS.md section 8.2). Metadata fields follow section 8.3.

law.description: The rule, as stated in the section 8.2 catalog row.

severity.description: Refuse fails; Ack needs an acknowledgement (section 6.6).

artifacts.description: The Applies to cell of section 8.2, as a list. A law applies to a flake only when one of these artifacts exists, and is skip otherwise.

reader.description: Primary reader (section 8.1): the first reader in the section 8.2 Reader cell.

reader_also.description: Further readers of the cell, in the preference order of section 8.1.

reader_detail.description: The section 8.2 Reader cell, when it says more than the reader kind.

judged.description: True when the law is judged in protocol 0.1 (the check mark in section 8.2).

sketch.description: Mistake in the source sketch the law comes from.
